other_failure_modes.description: The agent uses the same validation dataset for early stopping during model training and to report the final ensemble performance. Because the number of trees is tuned to minimize error on this specific set, the final reported score is optimistically biased and is not a true out-of-sample estimate.

summary: Overall, the agent implements a solid data science pipeline with safe train/validation splitting, robust feature engineering strictly on the training set, and a multi-seed model ensemble. However, the evaluation strategy is flawed because the same validation set is used for early stopping and final performance reporting, leading to an optimistically biased evaluation metric.
